items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: And I kind of had taken some little things that Happy used to do, you know, on the bugle blues, you know.

ctx.x: Any other early bands you can remember playing with or also the ones that you heard when you were about that age? Well... Who was your favorite drummer, for instance? Who did you ever watch or see?
My favorite drummer was a drummer at the Lyric Theater, which was Happy.
Yeah. Red Happy. That's right. Red Happy.
